mapper.select: select A.id, A.org_id, A.room_id, A.table_id, A.data_label, A.data_value, B.name, A.updated_datetime, A.updated_by from configuration A inner join table_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.room_id = A.room_id and B.table_id = A.table_id

select A.id, A.org_id, A.room_id, A.table_id, A.data_label, A.data_value, B.name from configuration A inner join table_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.room_id = A.room_id and B.table_id = A.table_id where A.org_id = #{orgId} and A.room_id = #{roomId} and A.table_id = #{tableId} and A.data_label = #{dataLabel} and A.data_value = #{dataValue}
mapper.update: update configuration set data_value = #{dataValue}, updated_by = ( select B.name_eng from users A inner join user_profile B on B.org_id = A.org_id and B.user_id = A.user_id where A.username = #{updatedBy} ), updated_datetime = NOW() where table_id = #{tableId} and data_label = #{dataLabel} and data_value <> #{dataValue}
